'''Asotost Lemme''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], possibly fictional, who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] some time before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. His heroic fight against a massive [[Sher Kar/Legends|Sher Kar]] was depicted in the painting ''[[Padawan Training]]''.<ref name="SWG:PT" />
